mapper.sql: record_id AS recordId, project_id AS projectId, env_id AS envId, url_id AS urlId, request_method AS requestMethod, request_url AS requestUrl, request_headers AS requestHeaders, request_query AS requestQuery, request_body AS requestBody, body_type AS bodyType, response_status AS responseStatus, response_headers AS responseHeaders, response_body AS responseBody, cost_ms AS costMs, success, error_msg AS errorMsg, operator, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_test_record (project_id, env_id, url_id, request_method, request_url, request_headers, request_query, request_body, body_type, response_status, response_headers, response_body, cost_ms, success, error_msg, operator) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{envId}, #{urlId}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestHeaders}, #{requestQuery}, #{requestBody}, #{bodyType}, #{responseStatus}, #{responseHeaders}, #{responseBody}, #{costMs}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM api_test_record ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM api_test_record WHERE url_id = #{urlId} ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM api_test_record WHERE create_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM api_test_record WHERE success = 0 AND create_time >= CURDATE()
